notes.title: Fight Life: Vanguard exclusive Demo Update for Ukrainian Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!
We’ve prepared an exclusive Demo update packed with exciting improvements:
[olist]
Active skills – each character now has their own unique active ability.

More loot & artifacts to discover and collect.

Magic scrolls have been added for even more tactical options.

New trader – buy and sell loot, potions, scrolls, and artifacts.

Mage upgrade – enhanced attack: can now strike immediately without switching to an area-of-effect attack.

UI improvements – big thanks to all our playtesters for their valuable feedback.

Balance adjustments – smoother difficulty progression.

Bug fixes for a better overall experience.
[/olist]
Wishlist on Steam and Follow us on X/Twitter! This is the best way to support our game.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927700/Fight_Life_Vanguard/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Fight Life: Vanguard | Localization Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927700?utm_source=ugf2024&utm_campaign=locupdate

Hello gamers,

We want to announce a list of languages that Fight Life: Vanguard is going to support:
- Ukrainian
- English
- Japanese
- French
- German
- Italian
- Spain
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Traditional Chinese
- Simplified Chinese
- Korean

Happy gaming,
Two Cakes Studio
